notes.title: Patch 1.0.8 - Toggle Skills!
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.8 is live, featuring a large number of minor bug fixes and tweaks!

During your travels through the World Fractures, you're going to rack up quite the skill repertoire! To streamline party customisation for you, we've added the ability to 'toggle' which skills you'll see in battle!

All you need to do is enter the 'Skills' section of the game's main menu, then hit SHIFT on any skills you want to hide from your battle menu.

Hopefully this further improves your experience with the game!

notes.title: Game Guides now Available!
notes.notes:
Now available - a series of guides currently clocking in at around 150 pages of data, game lore and more!

Though the walkthrough is not complete, I figured the ones that [b]are[/b] complete will still be invaluable for you guys, particularly the class and acquisition information, along with the inventory and crafting guide.

Rest assured that I'll be updating the walkthrough on a regular basis until complete.

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey! Most notably, you can all access the 'Datastorm' minigame by using code 855855 in the Victorium Inn!

I'm also starting to implement some post-game content, including the ability to roll-back your save to before the end boss (you won't lose exp or anything though) and a post-game boss challenge.

More to come! I'm also working on getting the complete guide finished!

# v1.0.6 Change Log
# Added a post-game menu - you can roll back your save file (keeping party etc intact) and fight some new bosses!

# Added character portraits for the Datasan, The Hermit, Levant and Lelouche
# Marcus will no longer wander around while you're still talking to him
# Removed 'incomplete' Ethyr trail in Northwest Utania
# Addressed a collision issue in O'Sola
# 'O'Solan Temple achievement now unlocks upon actually entering said temple
# Illucien Spirit Core now adds the correct summon skill
# You can now only obtain a single Illucien Spirit Core
# Added 'Sustainability' to Kal's skill repetoire, preventing him from losing Experience when not engaging in combat.
# Fixed some continuity issues with Alzeer's dialogue regarding Trioarch.
# Reduced the craft cost of the Absentis Numeri Spirit Core.
# Added a slight delay to multiple collisions on puzzle balls in the O'Solan Temple.
# Addressed a room in said temple where you'd be able to return and get stuck.
# Darkness Envelopes' cast text now fits
# Lucile no longer refers to teammates as 'cretins' in battle ;)
# You can no longer 'warp out' of the END.
# Majiqual mines can no longer avoid their own attacks
# Increased the starting level of all characters obtained after Lucile, Thanier and Damasc.
# Increased the damage rate of the Lumosal Spell
# Torture now deals damage rather than healing enemies
# Reduced the number of Cava in 'Level 1: Desert'
# Tweaked the settings of the Magalixir Tonic and the associated Pack
# Addressed any issues associated with the Mind's Eye special item
# Added a bonus item (choice) which can be gained by entering a code given to you for completing the tower in Corruption
# Added the 'Datastorm' bonus item which initiates a space-shooter minigame (Code: 855855)

notes.title: Patch Note
notes.notes:
Mostly minor things that needed addressing as per the bug reports, however there was one major change that I wanted to make everyone aware of!

Changing the game window's size/fit-screen options are now located in the menu's 'System' section. This allows you to change the setting as you see fit, whenever you like, and will also be saved to your save file.

I thought this would make things a little more streamlined for you guys.

EDIT: 1.0.4 is now live, featuring two class branches that were previously 'hidden'. Enjoy!

notes.title: We've gone to retail!
notes.notes:
Hurrah! Confetti, cheering people, hands clapping!

It's been a long, long road to this point. And there's much more to come - no doubt there will be a couple of minor bugs here and there (such is the nature of software) which I'll address as they're mentioned in the forums. 

I have some pretty cool idea for free DLC packs for you guys, which I'll get to working on right away. 

There's also the inevitable sequel which is planned, but for the moment I'm going to start on something a little... different to my usual work. I'll keep you posted on that one, of course. 

For now, old fans and new, please do enjoy the latest in the Datastream Saga. There's much more to come, so < insert cliché here >.

notes.title: Build v1.0.0 is here!
notes.notes:
We're pretty much ready to go to retail! Thank you all, so much, for your help in addressing bugs and balancing issues during our time in Early Access.

I'm going to give it another few days, during which time I'll be playing through the game again in the hope that taking different customisation paths will open up some more opportunities to fish out and tweak any abnormalities throughout. 

Thanks again guys! We did good.

Please, please drop by the store page and stick a review up. It really helps for potential customers to see what you've enjoyed and disliked about the game (if anything at all) during your time experiencing it.

notes.title: V0.9.8 Change Log
notes.notes:
We're at a point now where I'm relatively happy with the content level of the game, though I do have some ideas for free DLC updates after the retail launch.

Now all that's left to do is thoroughly test the game to ensure balance and compatibility! To do this I'm doing a thorough play-through myself, as well as taking on board the observations of the other beta testers.

I'd like to take this opportunity to thank the testers for helping the project to grow and ensure that the game is as enjoyable as possible for all Data Hacker fans.

v0.9.8 Change Log:
New Content and Additions:
# Victorium's Questor now gives out more side-missions!
# Character profile documents will now be given whenever you recruit a new character
# Some enemies will now drop their associated cards for use in Trioarch matches
# Added in all new in-game milestones and Steam achievements
# Added code for the final Familiar Absentis Numeri - which includes a 'hack all' skill
# Added a 'Post-game' feature - more on this later
# Added 'Locales' documents for the main areas of the game
# Added a series of side-missions accessable from the Questor in the Victorium inn.
# Added a TON of Trioarch cards. You can now play Trioarch with a bunch of characters throughout the game
# Added character portraits for the Timeshifter and the Interface
# Changed the core coding to allow you to have any combination of characters in your party, without effecting dialogue.
# Added in the ability to obtain all 71 Trioarch cards throughout the game

# Tweaks and Fixes
Working through and balancing the entire game thoroughly - way too many points to mention
# Starting a new game will function correctly now
# Addressed a script error for old save files
# Jump tutorial now shows before a jump event
# Fixed some overlay issues in the Ornatice Manor
# Changed the configuration for how the ending plays out, and added a Thanier-Anyia scene

That's all from me for now... back to playing the game!

notes.title: V.0.9.5 Change Log
notes.notes:
There's a lot of new content to be feasted-upon guys. Before the full release, I still need to add some more content such as Trioarch Cards, Steam Achievements and a couple of other bits, then run through and do a thorough difficulty test... then we're ready to go to retail!

# v0.9.5 Change Log:

# New Content and Additions:
# Added two new 'Fighter' skills - Feral and Primal Chants. They drain MP to boost TP. Unlocked at levels 2 and 15 of the Fighter class.
# Kal's 'Mind's Eye' cutscene is now implemented in its draft state
# New cores - Discrimination Augment Cores - reduce random encounter rates
# Finished up the 'Desert Mall' endgame dungeon! Can be accessed by returning to the Cavo Pyra dungeon and clearing out all of the Darkfestations there
# Added a double-credit-droprate Augment core - found in the Desert Mall
# Added a new endgame sidequest which can be initiated by first talking to Jaisone in Victorium, then the enigmatic character in the Desert Mall
# Introducing 'The Remembered' dungeon, which features homages to Kickstarter backers, as well as a Ghoul-hunting sidequest
# Finished coding the end sequence, including cutscene, credits and flagging your save file as complete
# Added the remaining Grindhouse Doors throughout the game, culmimnating in a special boss fight
# Added some new Armour sets
# Added MKII armour set recipes and recipe book (which can be purchased)
# Finished putting together the Pleizoic Endgame content featuring the Cava Viri
# Finished adding Mind's Eye flashback cutscenes, at least for now

# Tweaks and Fixes:
# Usual tweaks for typos, collision errors and other little bits.
# Addressed an issue where people could use quick fingers to double-jump off the map
# Equipping a Spirit Core will once again allow the character to summon the Familiar in battle
# New skill types will be added when switching to the appropriate class - i.e. Psymance for a Psychic class
# Slightly altered the names of a few augment Cores
# Spirit Cores and Augment Cores now have different icons
# A few summon skills now have different hued icons
# Altered a few weapon sound effects
# Switches in Ornatice now work correctly without freezing the game upon an incorrect input
# Kat's Data Hack should now work correctly 
# Tweaked the achievements coding a little in preparation for a full roster of Steam Achievements

notes.title: v0.8.1 Change Log
notes.notes:
# v0.8.1 Change Log:

Tweaks and Bug Fixes:
# Usual typo, text-wrapping and collision tweaks/fixes
# Fixed a bunch of typing inconsistencies
# Some enemies now have a weakness to Dragonfire
# A large amount of tweaks to skills and classes, including descriptors for buffs
# Addressed an out-of-place border graphic error in Vic.
# Removed some of the apartments from Metros, which gives a clear path if needed
# Blocked off Utania Ethyr trail until the area is complete.
# Stopped the Enigmatic man from turning into a wisp after talking to him.
# Xzus' sprite will no disappear after cutscene as intended (O'Sola)
# Levant will now hand over Damasc's weapon twin as intended (O'Sola)
# Halberdier's Offensive stance will now only affect himself, rather than the whole party (O'Sola)
# Stopped Temple of Light entrance cutscene from repeating (O'Sola)
# Fixed the Grindhouse entrance 'finicky-ness'

New Content and Additions:
# Introduced the 'Convergence' endgame dungeon. The World Shard for this area can be found in the Temple of Light (O'Sola)
# Equipping a Familiar now allows the user to absorb certain elemental damage
# Added some more foliage to the edges of Pleizoic
# Gave the Ornatice Witch (Alexandia) a dialogue portrait
# Added some Containers to Anyang & Outers.
# Added a series of Fortune-based states which update at the start of battle and can increase a number of 'chance' effects like Critical hits
# Chips can now be used to induce an aura that have various positive effects that last around 9 turns in battle
# Data Core Tz can now be used to permanently boost a character's stats
# Updated a number of characters with new graphics
# Added Psymance and Induction skill types, for better categorisation
# Weapons Vendor in Victorium will now actually sell some Special Augment Cores.

notes.title: V 0.7.6 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
# v0.7.6
# Usual typo fixes and collision tweaks
# Changed the window skins to something a lot nicer, in-theme and sleek
# Greetings guy in Utania no longer causes the game to crash
# Cemetary Caretaker now only gives rewards once.
# Adjusted Damasc's Pickpocket to identify and target specific items
# Also adjusted the skill to have a lower success rate
# Added a 'steal buff' to certain classes
# Hopefully fixed the 'failed to draw bitmap' errors once and for all. 
# Organis doors are now set to work on touch, which should alleviate a bug where they were only one-way
# Tweaked weaknesses and resistances of mobs throughout the game
# Added the Bandit's Core, which can be found in the O'Solan Sewers. It increases stealing chances.
# Added a craftable, dungeon-specific Augment core for Ornatice. The craft book can be found in a 'hidden' cave in Ornatice
# Added a dungeon-specific Augment core for Organis, whose craft book can be found in the nerve centre.
# Added a missing file from the Grindhouse area that caused the game to crash
# Updated a number of placeholder character graphics with their 'final' versions
# Added a cameo from Initiation/Corruption that will eventually lead onto a sidequest
# Prevented Anyang guards from venturing into the overlay from below
# Fixed the Anyang Manny encounter trigger issue
# Fixed the Anyang door
# Updated the Cava spawns in Anyang
# Added a confirmation from Thanier about defeating the Darkfestations in Anyang.
# Added a few additional methods of obtaining World Fragments in Anyang.
# Stopped premature activation of the Warehouse scenes
# Leon-Ex's sprite disappears during Victorium inn scene, as he should
# Turned off ghost mode after scene in Warehouse

notes.title: V 0.7.3 Change Log
notes.notes:
So! I intend to be releasing patch notes every time I make a significant update to the game. Today is mostly fixes and tweaks, but most notably, I've dropped the script that was used to fullscreen the game, in favour of one that resizes to the monitor's proportions. 

For those of you with an existing save file, you can save your preferences (that would normally be set at game start) by opening up the Beta console and hitting 'resolution settings'. There, you can switch between 960x540, 1440x900 or what I like to call 'fitscreen' (kinda like fullscreen, but it's still technically in windowed mode).

# v0.7.3

# Fixed more collision errors
# Fixed Thanier's spritesheet re floating pixels
# Selecting God Mode will now toggle.
# Selecting Ghost mode will now toggle.
# Confirmation message added to ghost and god mode toggles
# You can now summon Anyia manifest and recall as often as you like
# Stopped plateau monsters from enraging too early in the game
# Fixed a bug whereby the parallax in the plateau forest would repeat
# Fixed a looping error on the victorium skeleton
# Fixed victorium's south-eastern bridge
# Shady looking man speech now doesn't offer a 'yes' function.
# Shady looking man's graphic has been updated
# Ages Warrior man's graphic has been updated
# Fixed Organis doors.
# Hopefully fixed all Totemas
# Stopped the Navigation Tutorial from repeating
# Fixed an overlay issue with the Vic. Workshop
# Estate Agent no longer respawns
# Beta console no longer has a target, just works when selecting it
# Jump tutorial is now centred on the screen
# Added current build version to the title screen
# Experiment - you will now get the option to fit the screen to your monitor at game start, or play in the default resolution. Existing save files can select their default through the Beta Console.
# Reduced the game's overall install files by (safely) removing a duplicate folder
# Updated soundtrack with a couple of new tracks
# Updated Damasc's profile document description

Much love, hackers. Hope you enjoy the update!
